as_told.title: CIA approached Gary Nolan about the biological effects of UAP encounters

plain: The CIA came to a Stanford scientist named Garry Nolan with files on people who had had strange, unexplained experiences, according to Michels, who says the agency told Nolan "we have these files of people who've had all these anomalous experiences." Michels tells it himself on two episodes, once dating the approach to around 2016 and framing it as being about the bodily effects of encounters with UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. If true, it would mean the CIA was quietly studying the health effects of such encounters.
